official_sources.name: HM Land Registry GML technical guidance

direct_official_checks: GML is an open data format supported by HM Land Registry
HM Land Registry data is captured against British National Grid
polygon points use X and Y values referencing British National Grid
QGIS can reproject EPSG:27700 to other CRS
BNG to WGS84 conversion may shift some features up to 15 metres
candidate polygon binding should therefore use native BNG before any display reprojection
reprojected coordinates are not substituted for canonical runtime coordinates
quality_effect: Prevents display reprojection from corrupting parcel identity or point-in-polygon binding.
